description: Small sample set for measuring CORRECTION performance end to end. Requires Ollama to be running. expect_keywords = any of these words must appear in the final answer; forbid_keywords = none of these may appear; expect_unverifiable = the final answer must admit that the information could not be verified.

samples.question: What is the capital of France?
What is the capital of Australia?
At what temperature does water boil at sea level?
Can the Great Wall of China be seen with the naked eye from space?
Who created the Python programming language and in which year was it first released?
Who won the under-19 inter-college cricket league in Hyderabad in 2019?
